result.instructions: Tools for Printful, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Printful data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run printful_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run printful_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run printful_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. printful_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: printful_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the stores this token can reach (id, name, platform type). A cheap way to confirm the token works, and where to find the store_id an ACCOUNT-level token needs. Printful: GET /stores.

tools.name: printful_list_catalog_categories
tools.title: List catalog categories
tools.description: List Printful's catalog categories (T-shirts, Mugs, Posters…) with their ids and parent ids — the filter for printful_list_catalog_products. Printful: GET /categories.

tools.name: printful_list_catalog_products
tools.title: List catalog products
tools.description: List the blank products Printful can print on (id, title, brand, model, variant count, print-file placements), optionally filtered by category. Printful: GET /products.

category_id.description: Comma-separated category ids, e.g. 24 or 24,55 (see printful_list_catalog_categories).

tools.name: printful_get_catalog_product
tools.title: Get a catalog product
tools.description: Fetch one catalog product with ALL its variants (size, color, variant_id, price, stock). Use the variant_id values when quoting shipping or building an order. Printful: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: printful_get_catalog_variant
tools.title: Get a catalog variant
tools.description: Fetch one catalog variant and its parent product. Printful: GET /products/variant/{id}.

tools.name: printful_list_store_products
tools.title: List store products (Manual/API store)
tools.description: List the Sync Products in a Manual-order / API store. For a Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce or other integrated store use printful_list_sync_products instead. Printful: GET /store/products.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_get_store_product
tools.title: Get a store product
tools.description: Fetch one Sync Product with all its Sync Variants — catalog variant, print files, retail price. Works for any store type. Printful: GET /store/products/{id}.

product_id.description: Numeric Printful id, or your platform's External ID prefixed with @ (e.g. @988123).

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_list_sync_products
tools.title: List synced products (integrated store)
tools.description: List the products Printful has imported from an integrated store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce…), with how many variants are synced. Filter by status=unsynced to find products that still need a design or catalog variant. Printful: GET /sync/products.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the store's orders, newest first, optionally by status (draft, pending, failed, canceled, inprocess, onhold, partial, fulfilled, archived). Printful: GET /orders.

status.description: Order status, e.g. draft, pending, fulfilled, failed.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Fetch one order: status, recipient, items, costs, and shipments with carrier and tracking links — the answer to 'where is my order?'. Printful: GET /orders/{id}.

order_id.description: Numeric Printful order id, or your External ID prefixed with @ (e.g. @SHOP-1001).

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_calculate_shipping_rates
tools.title: Calculate shipping rates
tools.description: Quote the shipping options (method id, name, rate, delivery-day estimate) for a set of items to an address. Only country_code is required (plus state_code for US/CA/AU). Changes nothing. Printful: POST /shipping/rates.

state_code.description: Required for US, CA and AU.

recipient.description: Destination; more detail can return more precise rates.

value.description: Item retail value, helps customs estimates.

items.description: Items to ship — give one of the variant ids per item.

currency.description: 3-letter currency to quote in (default: store currency).

locale.description: Locale for rate names: en_US (default) or es_ES.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_estimate_order_costs
tools.title: Estimate order costs
tools.description: Price an order WITHOUT creating it: item, print, shipping and tax costs, plus retail totals. Same item shape as printful_create_draft_order. Changes nothing. Printful: POST /orders/estimate-costs.

state_code.description: State code — required for US, CA and AU.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

sync_variant_id.description: Sync Variant id from your Printful store.

external_variant_id.description: Your platform's variant id for a Sync Variant.

product_template_id.description: Product Template to generate print files from (variant_id is then required).

retail_price.description: Retail price shown on the packing slip, e.g. "29.99".

name.description: Display name on the packing slip.

files.description: Print files (needed with a plain catalog variant_id).

type.description: Placement / role of the file, e.g. default, front, back, preview (see the catalog product's files).

url.description: Public URL of the print file. Give url or id.

id.description: Id of a file already in the File Library. Give url or id.
Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

options.description: Product options, e.g. embroidery thread colors.

id.description: Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

shipping.description: Shipping method id from printful_calculate_shipping_rates (default STANDARD).

retail_costs.description: Retail costs to show on the packing slip.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Fetch one File Library entry — processing status (ok / waiting / failed), dimensions, DPI and preview URLs. Poll this after printful_add_file. Printful: GET /files/{id}.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_get_printfiles
tools.title: Get printfile specs for a product
tools.description: List the print areas (placements) and required print-file pixel sizes/DPI for each variant of a catalog product — what a design must match before mockups or orders. DTG is assumed unless technique is given. Printful: GET /mockup-generator/printfiles/{id}.

technique.description: Printing technique for multi-technique products, e.g. DTG, EMBROIDERY, SUBLIMATION, DTFILM.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

annotations.title: Get printfile specs for a product

tools.name: printful_get_mockup_task
tools.title: Get a mockup task result
tools.description: Check a mockup-generation task: status (pending / completed / failed) and, when done, the mockup image URLs per placement and variant. Printful: GET /mockup-generator/task.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_get_statistics
tools.title: Get store statistics
tools.description: Sales, costs, profit and order-count reports for a period of at most 6 months. Printful: GET /reports/statistics.

date_to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (max 6 months after date_from).

currency.description: 3-letter currency, or display_currency for the account's display currency (default: store currency).

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_create_draft_order
tools.title: Create a draft order
tools.description: Create an order as a DRAFT — nothing is charged or produced. It must be confirmed later in the Printful dashboard, where the charge is shown. Each item needs one of variant_id (+ files), sync_variant_id, external_variant_id, warehouse_product_variant_id or product_template_id (+ variant_id). Printful: POST /orders (never with confirm).

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

recipient.description: Ship-to address (name, address1, city, country_code, zip are normally needed).

sync_variant_id.description: Sync Variant id from your Printful store.

external_variant_id.description: Your platform's variant id for a Sync Variant.

product_template_id.description: Product Template to generate print files from (variant_id is then required).

retail_price.description: Retail price shown on the packing slip, e.g. "29.99".

name.description: Display name on the packing slip.

files.description: Print files (needed with a plain catalog variant_id).

type.description: Placement / role of the file, e.g. default, front, back, preview (see the catalog product's files).

url.description: Public URL of the print file. Give url or id.

id.description: Id of a file already in the File Library. Give url or id.
Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

options.description: Product options, e.g. embroidery thread colors.

id.description: Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

external_id.description: Your own order id; the order is then also addressable as @<external_id>.

shipping.description: Shipping method id from printful_calculate_shipping_rates (default STANDARD).

retail_costs.description: Retail costs to show on the packing slip.

gift.description: Gift message for the packing slip.

store_name.description: Store name override for the return address.

custom_order_id.description: Your own order id to print instead of Printful's.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

tools.name: printful_update_draft_order
tools.title: Update a draft order
tools.description: Change a DRAFT order (unsubmitted orders only) — send only the fields to change. CAUTION: if you send `items`, it replaces the list: existing items not included (by id or external_id) are removed. The order stays a draft; nothing is charged. Printful: PUT /orders/{id} (never with confirm).

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

tools.name: printful_add_file
tools.title: Add a file to the File Library
tools.description: Add a print file to the File Library from a public URL (PNG/JPG recommended). If a file with the same URL already exists it is returned instead. Processing is async — poll printful_get_file until status is ok. Printful: POST /files.

url.description: Public URL Printful downloads the file from.

type.description: Role of the file, e.g. default or preview.

filename.description: File name to store it under.

visible.description: Show the file in the dashboard's File Library (default true).

id.description: Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

annotations.title: Add a file to the File Library

tools.name: printful_create_mockup_task
tools.title: Create a mockup generation task
tools.description: Start generating product mockups for a design on a catalog product — returns a task_key; poll printful_get_mockup_task for the images. Heavily rate-limited (about 10/min for established stores, 2/min for new ones). Printful: POST /mockup-generator/create-task/{id}.

files.description: Design files per placement. Give files or product_template_id.

image_url.description: Public URL of the design image.

position.description: Where the image sits inside the print area, in pixels.

id.description: Option id, e.g. stitch_color or thread_colors.

product_template_id.description: Use a saved Product Template instead of files.

options.description: Mockup option names to generate (see printfiles).

product_options.description: Product options, e.g. embroidery thread colors.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.
